policy.hardKnownWinnerScope: Full-world known winner with no more total reflections plus portal jumps than the reference. Other winners are review findings. Operation count is only a bounded geometric simplicity proxy, not logical difficulty.
policy.knownTargetCasesIncludeSourceSubsets: measured and reported, not a hard angle gate

limitations: Finite documented routes and sampled perturbations, not a proof about all continuous configurations.
A real isolated/joint conflict certifies geometry, not obviousness, novelty, difficulty or causal necessity of every tagged concept.
Topology changes, endpoint margins, longer winners and local winners are diagnostics. Current metadata that claims a catalogue winner but no longer replays is a stale-evidence failure.
Existing independent geometry, UI, identity/history and editorial tests remain necessary.
